explanations: The session snapshots each entity with a shallow spread ({ ...entity }), so the snapshot and the live entity share the same roster and waitlist arrays. When enroll() pushes onto course.roster, the snapshot's array changes too, and the !== comparison in changedColumns() sees no difference, so only scalar columns like seatsTaken and credits are written. The fix snapshots a deep copy (structuredClone) and compares columns by value (isDeepStrictEqual). In-place changes to nested arrays are then detected, and untouched entities still produce no UPDATE.
